strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the liquidity-grab candle level: for longs, at the top of the candle that swept support; for shorts, at the bottom of the candle that swept resistance.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab (below it for longs, above it for shorts) and take profit at a recent swing level in the reversal direction (recent high for longs, recent low for shorts).

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples include 15-minute and daily-context discussion

variants.target_note: Take profit at recent swing high/low
